data.name: Raghunandan
data.short_meaning: One who takes refuge in Rama
data.long_meaning: Raghunandan is a compound name consisting of two parts: Raghupati (Rama's feet) and Anand (bliss). The name signifies taking refuge in Rama, who embodies strength, courage, and protection. It is a tribute to Lord Rama, the revered deity in Hinduism and the central character of the epic Ramayana.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes devotion and faith in Lord Rama, the embodiment of dharma and righteousness. It is a reminder of the power of seeking refuge in God and staying steadfast in one's spiritual journey.

Thus, the name Raghunandan embodies the spiritual journey of seeking refuge in Lord Rama and experiencing the inner bliss. It signifies taking a step further towards spiritual growth through devotion and surrender.
